plan_a: Grixis Reanimator combo: mulligan aggressively toward a hand that can DISCARD a huge creature (Griselbrand, Atraxa Grand Unifier, Archon of Cruelty) via Faithless Looting / Cabal Therapy / Unmask, then REANIMATE it turn 1-2 with Reanimate / Animate Dead / Shallow Grave (Dark Ritual + Lotus Petal for speed). Griselbrand's draw-7 refuels and protects. Strip disruption with Thoughtseize/Cabal Therapy. Win fast before they set up.
plan_b: Mardu Energy aggro-disruption: deploy efficient threats (Ajani, Ocelot Pride, Guide of Souls, Amped Raptor, Voice of Victory), attack every turn and race their life total. Disrupt with Thoughtseize, Cabal Therapy, Orcish Bowmasters, and Swords to Plowshares; Wasteland/Karakas hit their mana. You are the AGGRESSOR: prioritize pressuring life and stripping their key piece over durdling.
